name: Gmail Assistant — Drafting

filters.receivedAfter: ={{ $now.minus({ hours: (parseInt($('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.hours, 10) || parseInt((($('Get Drafting Settings').all().find(i => i.json.key === 'lookbackDrafting') || {}).json || {}).value, 10) || 48) }).toISO() }}

options.thinkingMode: ={{ (() => { const s = $('Get Drafting Settings').all(); const g = k => ((s.find(i => i.json.key === k) || { json: {} }).json.value || ''); return g('n8nModel') && ['low', 'medium', 'high'].includes(g('n8nEffort')) ? 'adaptive' : 'disabled'; })() }}

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"isAppointmentRequest": false, "requestedTimeframeHint": "", "preferredStartDate": "", "preferredEndDate": "", "preferredPartOfDay": "any", "durationMinutes": 0, "needsReply": true, "draftReply": "Hi, thanks for your email -- I will follow up shortly.", "isConfirmingProposal": false, "confirmedSlotIndex": -1, "refersToEarlier": false, "referenceDescription": "", "referenceKeywords": ["budget"]}

parameters.content:
## Sender whitelist
To add or remove a sender this system watches and drafts replies for, edit the **Tracked Senders** data table (used by the node below).

Columns:
- matchPatterns: sender email(s), comma-separated for aliases
- senderName: display name used in the signature/prompt
- active: true/false (set false to pause without deleting)
- notes: tone/language instructions for the draft

description: Sub-workflow: reads Tracked Senders, drafts replies (48h lookback, deduped), negotiates and books appointments. Called by Gmail Assistant daily at 14:00 Europe/Rome.
